inputs.name: server
inputs.description: The host that runs the Velociraptor server and its GUI, as a map of one name to an address, or to a host object with an address and optional host_key, user, port, private_key_file or jump_hosts.

inputs.name: clients
inputs.description: Hosts that run the Velociraptor client, by name, in the same form as server. A client can be the server's own address under another name.

inputs.name: velociraptor_version
inputs.description: Velociraptor release to install, without the leading v.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the gzipped Linux binary for each architecture, x86_64 and aarch64, from the release page. Change these with velociraptor_version.

inputs.name: server_url
inputs.description: URL clients reach the server on, with the trailing slash, such as "https://dfir.example.com:8000/". When null, https://SERVER_ADDRESS:FRONTEND_PORT/.

inputs.name: frontend_address
inputs.description: Address the server listens on for clients.

inputs.name: frontend_port
inputs.description: Port the server listens on for clients.

inputs.name: gui_address
inputs.description: Address the GUI listens on. The default keeps it to the host itself, for a proxy or an SSH tunnel; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: admin_username
inputs.description: Name of the GUI user the circuit creates with the administrator role.

inputs.name: admin_password
inputs.description: Password of the admin user, at least 8 characters. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_admin_password; it never reaches state or the plan. Changing it sets the new one.

inputs.name: client_nonce
inputs.description: Shared secret every client presents to the server, such as the output of openssl rand -hex 16. Keep it the same for the life of the deployment: a client with another nonce is turned away. It never reaches state or the plan.
